items.title: Dallas Goedert (shoulder) is questionable to return in Week 12 against the Cowboys.
items.text: Goedert was injured on the first drive of the game and headed to the locker room. Zack Ertz and Johnny Mundt will likely see the majority of the snaps if Goedert can’t return. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Zay Flowers (ankle) was a full participant during Thursday’s practice.
items.text: Flowers was limited Wednesday but was upgraded to a full-go a day later. He’ll be a WR2 for the showdown against the Texans in Week 12. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Brock Bowers (ankle) was listed as a limited participant during Thursday’s practice.
items.text: Bowers was also limited during Wednesday’s session. The team remains optimistic that their star tight end will play in Week 12 against the Browns, but fantasy managers should be prepared to turn to another option. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Jahdae Walker caught 0-of-1 targets in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions.
items.text: Walker did not do himself any favors in this one. He got open on the Bears’ 10th drive, and Caleb Williams heaved a well-placed, desperate pass his way while evading pressure way downfield. Walker bobbled it, giving Lions S Kerby Joseph the chance to punch the ball out of his possession, resulting in a turnover on downs. Walker does not need to be rostered in 12-team leagues. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Kalif Raymond caught 3-of-5 targets for 20 yards in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions.
items.text: Raymond chipped in as needed in the Bears’ win. On his best play, he snagged a play-action pass and ran upfield for a first down on the Bears’ first drive. Raymond does not need to be rostered in 12-team leagues. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Sam Roush caught 5-of-5 targets for 31 yards in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions.
items.text: Roush’s role increased after Colston Loveland suffered a worrying knee injury early in the game. The rookie tight end showed off his physicality by running over a would-be tackler on an 11-yard gain on the Bears’ seventh drive. Backup TE Stephen Carlson caught 2-of-4 targets for 30 yards as well. Roush could be a TE1/2 against the Jaguars next week if Loveland is sidelined. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Luther Burden caught 3-of-7 targets for 44 yards in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions.
items.text: Burden’s impact on the game was bigger than it was in the box score. He went in motion and helped block on the interior for Kyle Monangai’s first rushing touchdown. Aside from that, Burden generated a 25-yard gain on a slick post route and a 15-yard gain that helped set up Rome Odunze’s 41-yard score. Burden nearly hauled in a 46-yard pass on the Bears’ eighth drive, but Caleb Williams overthrew him. items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) was a limited participant during Thursday’s practice.
items.text: Evans was a non-participant during Wednesday’s session, and seems very likely to be a solid option even against the tough Seahawks’ defense in Week 12. Jordan Watkins (groin) was listed as a non-participant for the Thanksgiving practice. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Broncos activated Tyler Badie off injured reserve.
items.text: Badie is back after missing a month with his thumb ailment. He’ll get some touches behind Jonah Coleman during Friday’s contest against the Steelers. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Rome Odunze caught 6-of-9 targets for 87 yards and two touchdowns in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions.
items.text: Caleb Williams and Odunze nearly linked up for a 20-yard touchdown during the Bears’ sixth drive, but the pass was a little too far outside the end zone for Odunze to get his feet down. Williams began looking his way more and more as the game progressed, and things really kicked off partway through the fourth quarter, when Williams hit Odunze on consecutive plays for a 15-yard gain and a 41-yard touchdown.
